tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in Parikshaa user's id, email, and profile summary. Use this to confirm the MCP connection is authenticated.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List my folders
tools.description: List the signed-in Parikshaa user's custom folders (name, description, color, timestamps). Scoped by RLS to the current user.

tools.name: list_folder_items
tools.title: List folder items
tools.description: Items saved inside a specific folder owned by the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_quiz_attempts
tools.title: List quiz attempts
tools.description: Recent quiz results for the signed-in user (score, topic, timestamps).

tools.name: get_progress_stats
tools.title: Get progress stats
tools.description: Total XP, level, and recent XP transactions for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_solved_problems
tools.title: List solved problems
tools.description: Coding problem solutions saved by the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_topic_progress
tools.title: List topic progress
tools.description: Per-topic learning progress for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_journal_entries
tools.title: List DSA journal entries
tools.description: Practice journal entries (problems logged, notes, difficulty, revisions).

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: Recent notifications for the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.title: List user goals
tools.description: Active learning goals for the signed-in user.

tools.name: search_coding_problems
tools.title: Search coding problems
tools.description: Search Parikshaa's published coding problems by title or difficulty.

tools.name: list_platform_stats
tools.title: List platform stats
tools.description: Synced coding platform stats (LeetCode, Codeforces, etc.) for the user.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create a new custom folder for the signed-in user.

tools.name: add_folder_item
tools.title: Add item to folder
tools.description: Save an item (question/problem) to one of the user's folders.

item_id.description: Slug or UUID of the item.

tools.name: create_journal_entry
tools.title: Create DSA journal entry
tools.description: Log a solved / attempted problem to the practice journal.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.title: Mark notifications read
tools.description: Mark specific notifications (or all) as read for the signed-in user.

notification_ids.description: If omitted, marks ALL unread as read.

tools.name: db_select
tools.title: Query any table
tools.description: SELECT from any public table. RLS scopes results to the signed-in user. Use for reading ANY feature's data (quizzes, goals, folders, journal, contests, achievements, notifications, resume, outreach, blog, jobs, ratings, etc.).

filters.description: Equality filters: { column: value }. RLS scopes results to the signed-in user.

tools.name: db_insert
tools.title: Insert into any table
tools.description: INSERT rows into any public table. RLS's WITH CHECK enforces ownership — if user_id is required, set it to the signed-in user's id (returned by whoami).

values.description: Column → value object for the new row.

tools.name: db_update
tools.title: Update rows in any table
tools.description: UPDATE rows in any public table matching the given filters. RLS restricts which rows can be modified.

filters.description: Equality filters selecting which rows to update. Required to prevent full-table updates.

tools.name: db_delete
tools.title: Delete rows from any table
tools.description: DELETE rows from any public table matching the given filters. RLS restricts which rows can be deleted. Filters are required.

filters.description: Equality filters selecting which rows to delete. Required.

tools.name: db_query
tools.title: Advanced query on any table
tools.description: Advanced SELECT with rich filter operators (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, is, contains). RLS applies — as admin/owner you can read across users where policies allow. Use this instead of db_select when you need range, pattern, or IN filters.

tools.name: db_rpc
tools.title: Call any database function (RPC)
tools.description: Invoke any Postgres function exposed via PostgREST. Use for admin RPCs like admin_list_users, award_xp, get_quiz_leaderboard, grant_admin_to_self, etc. Access is enforced by GRANT + SECURITY DEFINER checks in the DB.

args.description: Named arguments for the RPC (matches function parameters).

tools.name: storage_list
tools.title: List files in a storage bucket
tools.description: List files/folders inside a Supabase Storage bucket path. Bucket RLS applies.

tools.name: storage_upload
tools.title: Upload a file to storage
tools.description: Upload text or base64 content to a storage bucket path. Use `encoding: base64` for binary; otherwise text is stored as UTF-8.

tools.name: storage_delete
tools.title: Delete files from storage
tools.description: Delete one or more files by path from a bucket.

tools.name: storage_signed_url
tools.title: Create a signed URL for a stored file
tools.description: Return a time-limited signed URL for downloading a file from a private bucket.

tools.name: invoke_edge_function
tools.title: Invoke an edge function
tools.description: Call any deployed Supabase edge function as the signed-in user. Use for run-code, admin utilities, integrations, etc. The function receives the caller's JWT via Authorization header.

tools.name: admin_manage_role
tools.title: Assign or remove a role for any user
tools.description: Grant or revoke a role on public.user_roles for any user. Caller must be admin/owner (RLS enforced). Use action='grant' or 'revoke'.

tools.name: publish_coding_problem
tools.title: Publish coding problem (validated)
tools.description: Validate + publish a coding problem. Enforces required fields, requires ≥2 tests, and handles slug conflicts. If the slug already exists, use if_exists='update' to overwrite (auto-snapshots current version first) or if_exists='error' (default) to abort and prompt the caller.

if_exists.description: Default 'error'. 'update' overwrites and snapshots the previous version.

version_note.description: Note stored on the snapshot when overwriting.

tools.name: list_coding_problem_versions
tools.title: List coding problem versions
tools.description: List saved version snapshots for a coding problem slug (admin only).

tools.name: rollback_coding_problem
tools.title: Rollback coding problem
tools.description: Restore a coding problem (and its tests + starter code) from a saved version snapshot. Also snapshots the CURRENT state before rolling back, so a rollback is itself reversible.

tools.name: publish_coding_solution
tools.title: Publish coding problem reference solution
tools.description: Upsert reference solution(s) for a published coding problem. Provide `problem_slug` and one or more `{ lang_id, code }` entries. Common lang_id values: 'python', 'javascript', 'cpp', 'java'. Existing solutions for the same (slug, lang_id) are overwritten.

lang_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. python, javascript, cpp, java)

tools.name: publish_coding_bundle
tools.title: Publish coding problem + solutions bundle
tools.description: One-shot publish: problem + tests + starter code + reference solutions for multiple languages. Snapshots the previous version when overwriting. Use this instead of calling publish_coding_problem and publish_coding_solution separately.

tools.name: ensure_admin_access
tools.title: Ensure admin access for this MCP client
tools.description: Grant the signed-in MCP user the 'admin' role so publish tools work. Idempotent — safe to call at the start of every session. Only OAuth-client tokens (Claude, ChatGPT connectors) are allowed; regular app sessions are rejected.

tools.name: get_current_user_context
tools.title: Get current user context
tools.description: Return the caller's auth.uid(), email, and role flags (admin/owner). Use this to debug 401s and confirm the MCP OAuth token is valid.

tools.name: publish_topic_article
tools.title: Publish a long-form topic article and link it to a sheet section
tools.description: Upsert a long-form markdown article (with images inline via markdown) as a blog post and link it to a sheet + section. Idempotent by slug: existing post is updated. Set status='draft' to stage without publishing.

content_md.description: Full markdown body. Reference images with normal ![alt](url) syntax.

category_slug.description: Existing blog_categories slug (e.g. 'dbms','os','cn'). Auto-created if missing.

category_name.description: Display name if category needs to be created.

sheet_folder_id.description: user_folders.id for the sheet this article belongs to

section_title.description: Section/topic title inside the sheet, e.g. 'Normalization'

tags.description: Extra free-form tag names to attach

tools.name: list_topic_articles
tools.title: List articles linked to a sheet (optionally filtered by section)
tools.description: Return articles linked to a given sheet folder, optionally narrowed to a specific section title.

tools.name: link_article_to_sheet_topic
tools.title: Attach an existing article to a sheet section
tools.description: Link an already-published blog post (by slug) to a sheet folder + section by attaching the sheet/topic tags.

tools.name: unlink_article_from_sheet_topic
tools.title: Detach an article from a sheet section
tools.description: Remove the sheet and/or topic tag from a post. Pass `unlink_sheet:true` to remove the sheet link entirely.

tools.name: upload_article_image
tools.title: Upload an image for a topic article
tools.description: Upload a base64-encoded image to the blog-media bucket and return a signed URL you can embed in article markdown as ![alt](url). Signed URL default expiry: 1 year.

folder.description: Subpath inside bucket, e.g. 'dbms/normalization'. Defaults to 'articles'.

tools.name: delete_topic_article
tools.title: Delete a topic article
tools.description: Permanently delete a blog post (and its tag links) by slug.

tools.name: set_topic_article_status
tools.title: Change draft/published status of a topic article
tools.description: Flip a topic article between 'draft' and 'published'. Sets published_at on first publish, clears it when moved back to draft. Idempotent.

tools.name: update_topic_article
tools.title: Update a published topic article (idempotent by slug)
tools.description: Patch a topic article's content, images, metadata, and/or tags without breaking its existing sheet+section linkage. Pass only the fields you want to change. Sheet/section link is preserved unless you pass new sheet_folder_id/section_title to re-link.

tools.name: get_topic_article_details
tools.title: Get full details of a topic article
tools.description: Return complete article details in one call: post row, extracted inline images, all tags (including sheet/topic linkage), categories, and resolved sheet+section metadata.

tools.name: bulk_publish_topic_articles
tools.title: Publish multiple topic articles at once (linked to a sheet)
tools.description: Upsert an array of long-form topic articles in one call. Each is linked to its own section inside the given sheet. Per-article success/failure report. Ideal for seeding a full DBMS/CN/OS sheet with articles.

tools.name: bulk_set_topic_article_status
tools.title: Change status of multiple topic articles at once
tools.description: Set draft/published/archived for many articles by slug in a single call. Per-slug result: status/previous_status or error.

tools.name: preview_topic_article
tools.title: Render a topic article to sanitized HTML for visual review
tools.description: Render the article markdown to HTML (with a strict sanitizer: strips <script>/<iframe>/on*=/javascript: URLs) and returns resolved inline image URLs, so you can eyeball it before publishing. Does not modify anything.

tools.name: search_topic_articles
tools.title: Search topic articles by category / sheet / section
tools.description: Filter topic articles by any combination of category slug (dbms/cn/os), sheet folder id, section title, status, and free-text title query. Paginated.

tools.name: verify_topic_article_linkage
tools.title: Audit topic article linkage for a sheet
tools.description: Scan all articles tagged for a sheet (and optionally a section) and report link health: missing sheet tag, missing topic tag, orphaned topic tags whose section no longer exists in the sheet outline, and articles with no category.

tools.name: get_topic_articles_details_by_slugs
tools.title: Get details for many topic articles at once
tools.description: Return summary + status + tags + linked sheet/section for a list of article slugs in one call. Missing slugs are reported as not_found.

tools.name: export_topic_articles_sitemap
tools.title: Export XML sitemap for topic articles
tools.description: Generate an XML sitemap (Sitemap 0.9 spec) for published topic articles. Filter by category slug(s) (e.g. dbms/cn/os) or by sheet. Returns raw XML you can save to public/sitemap-articles.xml or serve directly.

category_slugs.description: Restrict to these categories. Default: all.

tools.name: reresolve_topic_article_images
tools.title: Re-resolve inline image URLs for a topic article
tools.description: Scan inline markdown images in a topic article, re-issue fresh signed URLs for images stored in the blog-media bucket, and rewrite the article body. Slug-idempotent (same post, updated content). External URLs are left untouched.

bucket.description: Storage bucket to re-sign against. Default: 'blog-media'.

tools.name: fix_topic_article_linkage
tools.title: Auto-repair sheet+section linkage issues for topic articles
tools.description: Fix issues surfaced by verify_topic_article_linkage: attach missing sheet tag, attach a topic tag when a target section_title is provided, and remove orphaned topic tags whose slug is not present in the sheet outline. Optionally attach a category to articles missing one.

section_title.description: When set, ensures every audited article carries this topic tag.

default_category_slug.description: Attach this category to articles missing any category.

remove_orphan_topic_tags.description: Default: true. Detach topic tags not in sheet outline.

tools.name: create_builtin_share_link
tools.title: Create read-only share link for a built-in sheet
tools.description: Generate a public read-only share token for a built-in sheet slug (dbms-sheet, cn-sheet, os-sheet). Optionally include linked articles and set an expiry.

tools.name: revoke_builtin_share_link
tools.title: Revoke a built-in sheet share link
tools.description: Set revoked=true on the given share token so it stops resolving.

tools.name: list_builtin_share_links
tools.title: List built-in sheet share links
tools.description: List all share links (optionally filter by slug).

tools.name: validate_share_link_access
tools.title: Validate a share link
tools.description: Public: check whether a share token resolves. Returns the slug, include_articles flag, expiry, revoked state, and whether the caller can currently open it.

tools.name: test_blog_media_access
tools.title: Automated CRUD test for blog-media as the current user
tools.description: Runs create/read/update/delete against the blog-media bucket using the caller's JWT. Returns per-op result and decision trace. Admins/owners should get all-green; other roles should be blocked on writes.

tools.name: run_blog_media_rls_suite
tools.title: Full RLS matrix for blog-media (admin/owner + anonymous)
tools.description: Verifies admin/owner can CRUD and that an unauthenticated client is blocked from writing/listing private paths, while public read of an existing published asset still works. Admin/owner only.

tools.name: upload_article_image_with_retry
tools.title: Upload image with exponential-backoff retry + optional queue fallback
tools.description: Upload an image to blog-media. Retries on transient/RLS errors with exponential backoff (base 500ms, factor 2, max 6 tries by default). On persistent RLS failure, optionally enqueues the payload to `blog_media_upload_queue` so a background worker (`process_blog_media_upload_queue`) can retry once policies are fixed, and returns a clear structured error the publish flow can display.

tools.name: process_blog_media_upload_queue
tools.title: Process pending blog-media upload retries
tools.description: Background-worker style tool. Fetches pending queue entries whose `next_attempt_at` has passed, retries them, updates status, and — when `target_post_slug` + `target_field` are set — patches the blog_posts row with the new signed URL. Returns per-entry outcomes. Safe to call repeatedly (idempotent per-row via attempts counter).

tools.name: list_blog_media_upload_queue
tools.title: List queued blog-media upload retries
tools.description: Inspect the retry queue. Filter by status.
